t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the the gnomes color correlates to either a light or dark forest. Some forests have more mushrooms than others so it is important to pay attention to that. The hat size doesn't have any correlation.

vb_textbox.text: During the experiment you will be presented with gnomes that have different colors (blue & purple, red & yellow, orange & brown, pink & green). The size of the hats doesnt seem to have any correlation with the amount of mushrooms, but the color of the hat does. Make sure to take mental note of which color is giving more mushrooms. I felt that the color/mushroom ratio did change with each round.
